title: Going to the dentist
whatHappens: Wait in the room, sit in the special chair, open your mouth, the dentist counts your teeth, done.

title: A check-up at the doctor
whatHappens: Say your name, step on the scale, the doctor listens to your chest, one question at a time, done.

title: Getting a haircut
whatHappens: Sit in the chair, the cape goes on, clippers buzz, hair falls, the cape comes off, done.

title: Riding the bus
whatHappens: Wait at the stop, get on, tap your card, sit down, watch your stop, pull the cord, get off.

title: Taking the train
whatHappens: Find the platform, check the board, board, find your seat, listen for your stop.

title: Going through the airport
whatHappens: Check bags, security: liquids out, walk through the scanner, collect things, find the gate, wait, board.

title: First day at a new school
whatHappens: Arrive at the gate, go to the office, meet the teacher, find your classroom, break time happens, home time.

title: First day at a new job
whatHappens: Arrive, say who you are at reception, meet your manager, get shown the desk and the tools, lunch happens, first task.

title: What the fire alarm sounds like
whatHappens: The sound starts, everyone walks out calmly, stand at the meeting point, the sound stops, we go back in. You can cover your ears.

title: Grocery shopping
whatHappens: Take a basket, find items on your list, queue, items move on the belt, pay, pack, done.

title: Eating at a restaurant
whatHappens: A waiter shows you a table, you choose food, food arrives, you eat, you ask for the bill, you pay.

title: Handling loud places
whatHappens: What loud places feel like, and three things you can do: ear defenders, a break outside, or leaving. All are okay.

title: Meeting new people
whatHappens: Say hello, say your name, one question each is enough. Leaving after a short time is allowed.

title: Having a blood test
whatHappens: Sit down, sleeve up, a tight band, a quick pinch, a small tube fills, a plaster, done in about two minutes.

title: Moving house
whatHappens: Boxes get packed, the van comes, things arrive in the new room in the same order, your bed is set up first.

title: When a teacher changes
whatHappens: The old teacher says goodbye, a new teacher has a different voice and different rules, and that is allowed to feel strange. The rules list stays the same.

title: A hospital appointment, step by step
whatHappens: Check in at reception, wait where it is quiet if you can, name called, appointment, next appointment booked, leave.

title: Bus route to work, first time
whatHappens: Check the time on the timetable app, stop A, three stops, get off at the stop before the bridge, walk two minutes.

title: Moving up to the next class
whatHappens: Same building, new room number, new timetable on the wall, you can take a photo of it.

title: What a job interview looks like
whatHappens: Wait, name called, sit, questions one at a time, you may take notes, you may ask for a question again, it ends on time.

title: Concerts, markets, and crowded streets
whatHappens: Plan the quiet exit first, earplugs in a pocket, a break is not leaving early, it is part of the plan.

title: Commuting by train
whatHappens: Platform board, quiet coach option, seat facing the wall, delay announcements are normal, not an emergency.

title: A calm haircut for adults
whatHappens: Book the first slot of the day, say exactly what you want, clippers or scissors, no small talk required.

title: Airport security without surprises
whatHappens: Liquids in a clear bag, laptop out, tell staff you are autistic if you want more time, it is allowed.

title: Food shopping on a low-energy day
whatHappens: Same list order as last time, quiet hour if the shop has one, self-checkout, headphones are fine.

title: Ordering food by yourself
whatHappens: Read the menu online first if you like, order exactly as written, asking for changes is normal.

title: New classmates and group work
whatHappens: Group work: one job each, you can ask for the written-instructions job, saying less is fine.

title: Changing support people or classes
whatHappens: One person leaves, a new one arrives, the notes about what helps you move with you.
